sources.evidence: Bermuda Craft Brewing's official About page states that it is a fully fledged microbrewery, that it launched Citra Smash, 64 West and Whitecaps, and that it brews and cans all beers in Bermuda at its new Riddell's Bay home.
The current official contact page lists Bermuda Craft Brewing at 26 Riddell's Bay, Warwick, Bermuda and states that its on-site micro-brewery makes craft beer and cider.
The official retail page states that all Bermuda Craft Brewing beers are brewed and packaged in Bermuda.
The official website identifies The Cayman Islands Brewery at 366 Shamrock Road, Prospect, Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands and presents Caybrew as its beer.
The current official Our Beers page lists Caybrew, Caybrew Light, Freestyle, Ironshore Bock, Hopnosis, Island Hopper, Mango Tango, Lagerhead, Oktoberfest, White Tip and 345 as brewery products.
The official sustainability page explicitly states that the company brews its beers locally in Cayman and describes spent grains left after brewing, confirming active beer brewing at the brewery.
